about_the_game:
"DinoGORE" is a prehistoric CAVEMAN SIM where the player controls GORACK, a hulking primal murder machine prowling the lands seeking WOMEN and MEAT!

The DEMO vs the COMPLETE GAME:

The latest version of the "DinoGORE" playable demo ( v.1.0.4 ) includes:

- A main menu that allows the player to begin a new game, load a saved game, and view the credits.
- An opening tutorial sequence that teaches the basic mechanics of the game.
- Access to "Gorack's Territory", a conflict-free environment where the player can save the game, store collected items and craft outfits that grant perks for the playable character.
- Access to "The Lagoon Zone", an open area where the majority of gameplay takes place.

The FINAL RELEASE will include:

- Several additional areas similar to "The Lagoon Zone" where the player will battle npc dinosaurs and rival cavemen, such as "The Volcanic Zone" and "The Jungle Zone".
- Story events that occur as the player explores the different zones.
- Over 50 different types of dinosaur species to fight!
- Outfits that can be made from each of the defeated dinosaurs if the in-game conditions are met.
- There will also be secrets to unlock like hidden cheat codes.

content_descriptors.notes: Less sexually explicit as GTA3, quite violent though

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (3.80 GHz)
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 780M Graphics
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Explore a brutal prehistoric world where DINOSAURS roam the land, sea and skies! Play as GORACK, a primal, hulking murder machine that battles enemies in ancient times! Make use of a wide range of attacks as you skin prey, gather skins for upgrade crafting and steal tribal women!
